stages.headline: With 24 m of fence, what is the biggest area of a rectangular garden, in square metres?
stages.headlineEnglish: With 24 m of fence, what is the biggest area of a rectangular garden, in square metres?
stages.problemText: With 24 m of fence, what is the biggest area of a rectangular garden, in square metres?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. A square is best: its side is 24 : 4 = 6 m. 2. 6 · 6 = 36 m².
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. A square is best: its side is 24 : 4 = 6 m. 2. 6 · 6 = 36 m².
